# Use Cases


Choose one of the following use cases to practice:

:::{.callout-tip title="Example Use Cases" collapse="true"}

- **A. Presentation Preparation**: Transform reports into compelling presentation content.

- **B. Competitive Analysis**: Analyze multiple competitor documents simultaneously

- **C. Training Accelerator**: Transform manuals into engaging content

- **D. Department-Specific Use Case**: Explore specialized applications for your department

:::

---

## A: Presentation Preparation

**Challenge:** Presentation due Friday

**Goal:** Transform reports into compelling presentation content.

**What you need:** 

- Real data/reports from your work
- A new Gemini Notebook

**Steps:**

1. Open [Gemini Notebook](https://notebooklm.google.com) 
2. Select **Create new**
3. Upload your report or data documents
4. Use this prompt in the chat (replace target audience and length):

::: {.callout-important title="Prompt" collapse="true"}
```markdown
Create a presentation outline with
- 5 compelling discussion points
- Supporting data for each point
- 3 key insights for executives
- 10 potential Q&A use cases

Target audience: "Board of directors"
Presentation length: "30 minutes"
```
:::

5. Save the result as a **Note**
6. Create an **Audio Summary** to practice your presentation
7. Create a **Mindmap** for a visual overview

---

## B: Competitive Analysis

**Challenge:** Understanding the competitive landscape

**Goal:** Analyze multiple competitor materials simultaneously.

**What you need:**

- Multiple competitor documents (reports, brochures, presentations)
- A new Gemini Notebook

**Steps:**

1. Open [Gemini Notebook](https://notebooklm.google.com) 
2. Select **Create new**
3. Upload multiple competitor materials
4. Use this prompt in the chat:

::: {.callout-important title="Prompt" collapse="true"}
```markdown
Compare these competitor documents and identify:
- Their main advantages
- Gaps in their offerings
- Opportunities for our company
- Price/positioning differences
Create a strategic summary.
```
:::

5. Save the result as a **Note**
6. Ask follow-up questions about specific competitors
7. Create a **Mindmap** to visualize the competitive landscape

---

## C: Training Accelerator

**Challenge:** Making technical content engaging

**Goal:** Transform technical manuals into engaging training content.

**What you need:**

- Technical manuals or training materials
- A new Gemini Notebook

**Steps:**

1. Open [Gemini Notebook](https://notebooklm.google.com) 
2. Select **Create new**
3. Upload your technical training materials
4. Use this prompt in the chat (replace the placeholder):

::: {.callout-important title="Prompt" collapse="true"}
```markdown
Transform this technical manual into
- 10 practical use cases/examples
- Interactive Q&A for self-review
- Checklist with key points
- Common mistakes to avoid
Make it engaging for [TARGET AUDIENCE].

[TARGET AUDIENCE] = "Project managers"
```
:::

5. Save the result as a **Note**
6. Create an **Audio Summary** for auditory learning
7. Ask for specific scenarios or case studies
